_meta.auth: header X-RD-Token: rdpk-... ; persist an Idempotency-Key per call
usage: prompt describes the SUBJECT only; prompt_style carries the pixel look
check_cost:true is a free dry run - verify a batch's price first
two-stage entries need input_image from the earlier still
reference_images (rd_pro) keeps characters consistent - reuse your favourite output

prompts.title: ground grass spring
prompts.prompt: single isometric medieval village asset: flat grassy ground block, fresh green spring, small flowers, new leaves, square isometric ground block
prompts.notes: validates: isometric ground block + tile_x/tile_y seamless flags | ground block like the Isometric Medieval Pack; tile_x+tile_y set so edges meet

prompts.title: road wang spring
prompts.prompt: dirt road tiles for a medieval village, wheel-rutted earth, fresh green spring, small flowers, new leaves
prompts.notes: validates: wang tileset mode - the whole road set from one call | wang tileset: 16px or 32px tiles, all edge combinations in one sheet

prompts.title: tree oak spring
prompts.prompt: single isometric medieval village asset: broad spreading oak tree, fresh green spring, small flowers, new leaves
prompts.notes: validates: tile_object prop mode | num_images=2 gives two variants of the same species

prompts.title: shop bakery
prompts.prompt: single isometric medieval village asset: bakery with brick oven chimney and bread sign

prompts.title: person minstrel
prompts.prompt: small chibi medieval character, front view, full body, on empty background: travelling minstrel with a lute, colourful patched cloak, mid-performance
prompts.notes: validates: rd_pro character sprite - keep the output, it feeds the two-stage animations | use a saved reference_image of your base villager for look consistency

prompts.title: icon talk
prompts.prompt: small game UI icon of speech bubble, simple, readable at tiny size
prompts.notes: validates: mini icon readability at tiny size | batch of 4 variants; keep the clearest

prompts.title: good bread
prompts.prompt: small game item icon of round bread loaf

prompts.title: goods sheet
prompts.prompt: inventory item sheet: wheat sheaf, bread loaf, flour sack, stone block, log stack, sand pile, paper, ink pot, pamphlet, pigment pots, cloth bolt, glass pane, garments, hammer tools, lute, gold coins
prompts.notes: validates: inventory_items atlas mode + include_downloadable_data | one call draws a matched set; include_downloadable_data returns the item atlas

prompts.title: ui panel
prompts.prompt: carved wooden-framed parchment UI panel, empty centre, game UI element

prompts.title: festival summer solstice
prompts.prompt: single isometric medieval village asset, wide festive scene: summer solstice festival, great bonfire, flower crowns, longest day celebration

prompts.title: walk4 peasant m
prompts.notes: validates: prompt-driven 4-angle walk GIF | 48px 4-direction walk cycle, transparent GIF

prompts.title: rot8 player
prompts.prompt: young organizer in green tunic, medieval
prompts.notes: validates: 8-direction rotation sheet | 8 directional views; return_spritesheet gives the 3x3 sheet

prompts.title: adv walking
prompts.notes: validates: two-stage advanced animation - needs a person-* output as input_image | two-stage: input_image = the person-* P0 sprite, native res, padded to 64px. Send native-res frame, pad to 64px, retry once on provider_busy

prompts.title: compare cottage fast
prompts.prompt: isometric medieval cottage, timber-frame and thatch
prompts.notes: validates: rd_fast quality floor | quality floor check: if Fast looks fine, filler assets get much cheaper

prompts.title: compare cottage plus
prompts.prompt: isometric medieval cottage, timber-frame and thatch
prompts.notes: validates: rd_plus middle tier | middle tier, same subject as the rd_pro cottages-set
